title: 2025 AMC 10A Problem 22
statement:
A circle of radius \(r\) is surrounded by three circles, whose radii are \(1,\) \(2,\) and \(3,\) all externally tangent to the inner circle and externally tangent to each other, as shown in the diagram below.

What is \(r?\)

solutions.text: The three outer centers \(A, B, C\) are pairwise \(AB = 1 + 2 = 3,\) \(AC = 1 + 3 = 4,\) and \(BC = 2 + 3 = 5\) apart, a \(3\)-\(4\)-\(5\) right triangle. Now apply Descartes’ Circle Theorem with curvatures \(1, \tfrac12, \tfrac13,\) and \(\tfrac1r,\) all mutually tangent: \(\frac1r = 1 + \tfrac12 + \tfrac13\) \(+ 2\sqrt{\tfrac12 + \tfrac16 + \tfrac13}\) \(= \tfrac{11}{6} + 2\sqrt{1}\) \(= \tfrac{23}{6}.\) Inverting, \(r = \tfrac{6}{23}.\) Therefore, the answer is B.
hints: The centers of the radius-\(1, 2, 3\) circles are pairwise \(3, 4, 5\) apart, forming a right triangle
Place the right angle at the origin and write distance equations for the inner center, or apply the four-circle curvature relation
